FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the latest fashions from the future. They are all wearing sleek, high-tech armor, and their hair is styled in the latest " cyber-sleek" looks.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We will no longer be bound by the constraints of medieval fashion. We will be... (he pronounces the word with a flourish)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's decree is put into effect, and the entire kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now adorned with neon lights and holographic projections. The knights are now riding hoverbikes, and the peasants are all wearing futuristic, high-tech clothing.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See, my friend? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's quite something, Your Majesty.

KING
(nodding)
Yes, yes. We must be bold. We must be... (he searches for the right words)...we must be retro-futuristic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his advisors, all of whom are dressed in the latest fashions from the future. They are all wearing sleek, high-tech armor, and their hair is styled in the latest " cyber-sleek" looks.

KING
(to his advisors)
We must... (he pronounces the word with a flourish)...we must make our empire the most... (he searches for the right words)...the most vaporwave in all the land.

ADVISOR 1 (he)
Yes, Your Majesty. We will make it happen.

ADVISOR 2 (she)
But, Your Majesty, what about the peasants? They will be confused by our new aesthetic.

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft. The peasants will... (he pronounces the word with a flourish)...they will be enlightened. They will see the beauty in our vaporwave empire.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision is now a reality. The entire kingdom is a futuristic, high-tech wonderland. The knights are now riding hoverbikes, and the peasants are all wearing futuristic, high-tech clothing.

KING
(to Zorvath)

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's quite something, Your Majesty.

KING
(nodding)
Yes, yes. We must be bold. We must be... (he searches for the right words)...we must be retro-futuristic.
